The '''Vella plains''' were grassy flatlands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Kor Vella mesa]] was located at the center of the Vella plains and the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] was built atop the mesa.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="SoF" /> The Vella plains were surrounded by the [[Rier'let]] mountain, the [[Denendre Valley]] and the [[Nomad Mountains]].<ref name="SWG" />
